title: Client call on the website launch

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Hello Ananya ji, awaaz aa rahi hai? Karan aur Ritu bhi call pe hain.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan Vikram, clear aa rahi hai. Sorry thoda late ho gayi, pichhli call lambi chal gayi.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Koi baat nahi. Aaj mainly launch date aur homepage pe baat karni thi.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan, wahi main bhi bolne wali thi. Hamare management ne bola ki launch shift karo.

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Shift matlab kitna? Hum 15 October ke hisaab se chal rahe the.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Unka kehna hai ki festive offers ready nahi hain, toh 15 ko live karke fayda nahi.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Samajh gaya. Kaunsi date soch rahe hain woh log?

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: 26 October, Monday. Us din tak offers aur stock dono ready ho jayenge.

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Hamare liye 26 theek hai, balki testing ke liye extra time mil jayega.

segments.speaker: Ritu Agarwal
segments.text: Design side se bhi koi dikkat nahi hai.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Toh final karte hain, website launch 15 se shift hoke 26 October ko hoga.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan, final. Main apne side email mein confirm kar dungi.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Ab homepage. Pichhle review mein aapne kaha tha banner bahut bhara hua lag raha hai.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan, aur colours thode dull lage. Brand ka orange zyada dikhna chahiye.

segments.speaker: Ritu Agarwal
segments.text: Main naya version bana deti hoon, banner mein text kam karke ek hi offer rakhenge.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Perfect. Kab tak dekh sakte hain?

segments.speaker: Ritu Agarwal
segments.text: Weekend beech mein hai, Monday tak revised homepage designs bhej dungi.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Ritu, Monday tak pakka, kyunki uske baad development start hona hai.

segments.speaker: Ritu Agarwal
segments.text: Haan Monday tak pakka, aap tension mat lo.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Ek aur cheez, hamare ek director chahte hain ki site pe live chat ho.

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Live chat ke liye kisi ko baithna padega, aapke paas support team hai?

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Abhi toh nahi hai, sach bolun toh.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Toh mera suggestion hai abhi live chat mat daalo, bina team ke ulta negative experience hoga.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan theek hai, live chat abhi rehne dete hain, launch ke baad dekhenge agar team bani.

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Staging ki baat kar lein? Aapki team ko review ke liye link chahiye hoga.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan, hamare product head khud click karke dekhna chahte hain.

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Main staging link set up karke share kar dunga, saare pages ke saath.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Karan, kab tak?

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Agle Wednesday ko staging link mil jayega, tab tak homepage bhi integrate ho jayega.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Agle Wednesday chalega. Waise hamari board meeting 20 October ko hai, usme bhi site dikhani hai.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Theek hai, board meeting ke liye alag se ek short demo bana denge, woh separate hai.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan please, woh baad mein discuss karte hain.

segments.speaker: Ritu Agarwal
segments.text: Product photos ka kya? Jo aapne bheje the woh kaafi heavy hain, page slow load hoga.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan woh photographer ne raw files bhej di thi shayad.

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Unko compress aur resize karna padega, sau se zyada images hain.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Ye kaam team dekh legi, abhi kisi ek ko assign nahi karte, jo free hoga woh karega.

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Theek hai, photos ka kaam pool mein daal dete hain.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Hindi version ka kya plan hai? Launch ke saath aayega?

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Honestly, 26 tak Hindi ka content aur translation dono ready hona mushkil hai.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Haan, translation agency ne bhi abhi tak rate nahi bheja.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Toh mera proposal hai Hindi version launch ke saath nahi, phase two mein aayega.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Agreed, Hindi phase two mein le lete hain. Management ko main samjha dungi.

segments.speaker: Ritu Agarwal
segments.text: Fonts ke liye mujhe Hindi ka font pehle se finalise karna hoga, par woh baad mein.

segments.speaker: Karan Mehta
segments.text: Payment page pe ek bug tha pichhle build mein, woh fix ho gaya hai bata doon.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Achha hai. Aur koi blocker?

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Nahi, abhi koi blocker nahi. Bas homepage aur staging pe dhyan dena hai.

segments.speaker: Ananya Deshpande
segments.text: Great. Thank you sab ko, Wednesday ko phir baat karte hain.

segments.speaker: Vikram Joshi
segments.text: Thank you Ananya ji, have a good weekend.

decisions.fact: The website launch moves from 15 October to 26 October.
The Hindi version will not ship with the launch; it moves to phase two.

action_items.fact: Ritu sends the revised homepage designs.
Karan sets up and shares the staging link for the client's review.
The product photos are compressed and resized; the team picks it up, nobody named.

distractors.fact: Live chat on the site was suggested and put off.
20 October is the client's board meeting, not the staging link's date.
